claims.statement: HAK-018b requires every page in the exact HAK-018a retained traversal to have exactly one Assessed or explicit Unassessed disposition; missing, duplicate, extra, or smuggled dispositions cannot silently leave traversal pages outside the coverage denominator.

HAK-018b binds each Assessed page to the exact HAK-014 receipt source_ref/raw-response digest/resource kind, deterministic HAK-016 coverage derivation, exact HAK-016 canonical-profile binding, and a common recorded normalization-policy id/digest/artifact ref across assessed pages; it does not replay HAK-014 against raw response bytes or independently verify normalization-policy artifact content.

HAK-018b deterministically aggregates HAK-016 applicability/match/missing counts across assessed retained pages, preserves NotApplicable/Absent/PartiallyPresent/Present distinctions, and forces any explicit Unassessed page to make the aggregate Indeterminate rather than silently shrinking the denominator.

HAK-018b fixes provider-population qualification, HAK-014 normalization input replay, normalization-policy content verification, provider authentication, raw-response content verification, entity projection verification, continuation-source verification, and temporal snapshot verification as unestablished by this tranche; tested coherent redigest attempts cannot promote those boundaries.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile the HAK-018b traversal coverage-set tooling.
Validate the HAK-018b JSON Schema syntax.
Lint the HAK-018b machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-018b HAK-010 precommitted obligation-to-step binding policy.
Run focused HAK-018b page-conservation, source-join, aggregation, boundary, digest, and schema-parity regressions.

required_negative_cases: traversal page omitted from coverage set
valid HAK-014 receipt from wrong source ref accepted
valid HAK-014 receipt with wrong raw response digest accepted
HAK-014/016 resource kind differs from traversal domain
selector missing from assessed page accepted
cross-page normalization policy artifact ref mismatch accepted
indeterminate aggregate promoted to Present after coherent redigest
provider population qualification promoted above NotEstablished
HAK-014 normalization input replay promoted above NotEstablished
normalization policy content verification promoted above NotEstablished
unknown coverage-set root field accepted by schema
unassessed page carries assessed fields accepted by schema
assessed page missing profile-binding digest accepted by schema

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to deterministic page-disposition conservation over the exact retained HAK-018a traversal, exact HAK-014/016/profile-binding/source joins, common recorded normalization-policy identity across assessed pages, deterministic retained-page selector aggregation, canonical profile/digest integrity, and tested anti-promotion boundaries; does not authenticate provider responses, replay HAK-014 against raw response bytes, verify normalization-policy artifact content, establish temporal snapshot consistency, establish provider-population-qualified coverage, establish semantic truth, upgrade upstream HAK qualification, or grant runtime authority
